I believe when you tried to insert the image into your post, there were two "http://" pieces of text in the link, thus leading to the image failing to show in your post. I attempted to take the link and put it in the address bar to see if it leads to an Imgur photo, but it shows that the image has been removed. I recommend that you create another player report with the updated screenshots inserted.

Thank you for the report, and have a great day!
